vopros: What do you know about Vita Kamliuk, a real estate agent in Los Angeles? Which brokerage is she with?

vyzhimka.tekst:
Vita Kamliuk is a licensed Los Angeles real estate agent currently affiliated with Compass. Her California license is DRE #02166055, and Compass lists her as a REALTOR® on its official site. ([compass.com](https://www.compass.com/agents/vita-kamliuk/?utm_source=openai))

She focuses on residential real estate across Greater Los Angeles, particularly the San Fernando Valley and Westside, including Sherman Oaks, Valley Village, Studio City, Tarzana, Westwood, Beverly Hills, and West Hollywood. Her Compass profile lists specialties including buyer representation, listings, relocation, and property management; she speaks English and Russian. ([askvita.com](https://askvita.com/?utm_source=openai))

Her background is somewhat unusual for an LA residential agent. According to her professional bio, she previously worked in commercial real estate, including roles with Knight Frank and Colliers International, before moving into Los Angeles residential real estate. Her site says she has roughly 18 years of industry experience and that her prior team handled more than 500 transactions. Those career claims are primarily from her own marketing materials, so I'd distinguish them from independently verified sales statistics. ([askvita.com](https://askvita.com/?utm_source=openai))

She was previously with Keller Williams Beverly Hills; a 2022 VoyageLA profile identifies her as working from the Keller Williams BH office. She has since moved to Compass. ([voyagela.com](https://voyagela.com/interview/exploring-life-business-with-vita-kamliuk-of-keller-williams/?utm_source=openai)) Recent 2026 professional posts also identify her as "Vita Kamliuk | Compass" and give Compass's brokerage license as DRE #01991628, corroborating that the Compass affiliation is current. ([linkedin.com](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/vita-kamliuk-3a53614b_beverly-hills-luxury-la-real-estate-weekly-activity-7495239590556078080-L1q9?utm_source=openai))

If you're considering hiring her, I can also look into her recent transaction history, listings/sales, client reviews, license status/disciplinary history, and how her track record compares with other agents in the LA neighborhoods you're interested in.
